definitions.team_synergy: Active synergy computed from CURRENT team composition (5 heroes in a battle squad). Resolved at squad-formation time, optionally applied to battle runtime via gated feature flag.
definitions.collection_synergy: Passive / account-wide bonus computed from OWNED roster milestones (e.g. owns N heroes of faction X). Independent of which 5 heroes are deployed. Strictly out-of-scope for this task; readiness-only.

current_team_synergy_v2_state.battle_integration_flag: OFF (gated; no buffs applied to combat)
current_team_synergy_v2_state.borea_visibility_in_codex: hidden / catalog-only consistent with global Borea policy

proposed_collection_synergy_categories.description: Bonus per X owned heroes of faction Y
Bonus per X owned heroes of element Z
Bonus per X owned heroes of rarity 5★ / 6★
Bonus per owning a thematic origin group (e.g. Olympian Pantheon)
Bonus per completing a specific mythic set (3-piece, 5-piece)
Bonus per owning N Divine Weapons (catalog count, not equip)

future_activation_prerequisites: Collection resolver in /app/backend/data/ as READ-ONLY first (mirrors RM1.33-A skill_kit_runtime_adapter pattern).
Account-owned hero source validation (no client-trust; server reads roster).
UI read-only preview screen reusing synergy-codex.tsx primitives (no buttons).
Reward/buff cap policy ratified (max 15% total, max 5% per category, see anti-whale caps).
Anti-whale runaway caps: no diminishing-returns exploit, no negative HP/atk multipliers.
Borea safety gate: greek_borea contributions to collection synergies must be hidden until Borea visibility unlocks. Legacy borea / primordial_gaia excluded always.
Battle engine integration only behind explicit COLLECTION_SYNERGY_BATTLE_ENABLED feature flag (default OFF).
DB write only after migration plan approved.
PvP impact frozen until separate balance review.
